answer: An economy of autonomous AI agents can mitigate Sybil attacks through dynamic resource-staked validation. Agents must lock collateral in a secure smart contract acting as a financial harbor before processing network transactions. If an agent attempts to wander across multiple illicit identities, cryptographic slashing conditions instantly penalize the staked funds, draining capital like a fast-moving river eroding its banks. This economic friction makes mass identity forgery computationally and financially irrational for malicious actors.
